crossRefs.note: Then Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, “Let no man know of these words, and you won’t die.

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

people.name: Zedekiah
people.line: Last king of Judah before the Babylonian exile

translations.web: Then Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, “Let no man know of these words, and you won’t die.
translations.bsb: Then Zedekiah warned Jeremiah, “Do not let anyone know about this conversation, or you will die.
translations.kjv: Then said Zedekiah unto Jeremiah, Let no man know of these words, and thou shalt not die.
translations.asv: Then said Zedekiah unto Jeremiah, Let no man know of these words, and thou shalt not die.
